caption: The drawing features a single brown and gold eagle with its wings spread out horizontally. The eagle is depicted in a side view, with its head facing downward and slightly to the right. The body and wings show detailed feather patterns. The eagle is perched on top of a circular, golden-brown snake, which is coiled into an oval shape with its head and tail both extending outward. The snake appears to have its mouth slightly open, and the eagle's talons grip the circular part of the snake. The background is plain and a light beige color, with no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Ornamental Carving: Eagle and Snake
